card.name: Inside split-up capitalized words
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of long all-caps words split into parts, mostly in boxed warning headings and product names, such as ADOLE-SC-ENTS, FL-AV-ORED and PEDI-AT-RIC.

card.writes: It pushes word-start pieces like 'ppy', 'vo' and 'Pi', which suggests it helps continue a split word.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of long capitalized words that get broken into pieces, like ADOLESCENTS or PEDIATRIC in warnings.
